_provenance: Same statistic and procedure as MAIN_PAIRED_AR.json (paired bootstrap over requests on summed paired request time, 10,000 replicates, seed 1729), computed from each run's own benchmark-rank*.jsonl rows, with plain autoregressive decoding measured in the same run as the method it is compared against. All rows are 128 MATH-500 prompts. Source jobs: bench-x2-dev128-27315, bench-nemotron-descendant-dev128-27322, bench-adapter-to14b-dev128-27316, bench-x1-aligned-n7b-27064.
